messages:
morgan: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: landed runtime memfix in staging, ran load tests, updated rollout plan.

sophia: Nice. Where's the PR? I can review later today.

morgan: PR #845 — https://git.redwood/infra/PR/845 :eyes:. Needs 2 reviewers for the nontrivial kernel change.

jamie: @sophia I'm free after 3pm PT, can take a look. Any test flakiness I should watch for?

morgan: Watch for increased tail latency in long-seq runs. I added a small script to reproduce: ```./tests/load_sim.sh --seq 4096 --qps 200 --duration 5m```

tomas: Can you drop the staging run id? I want to pull logs.

morgan: staging run id: stag-2026-03-12-07; logs at https://logs.redwood/stag-2026-03-12-07

eng-ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 2026-03-12T22:00Z -> 20% for 30m, then 80% -> 100% if no regressions. Triggered by: @morgan

alex: QA: pinging @qa-bot for signoff on canary test matrix. Are smoke tests green?

qa-bot: all smoke tests passed on canary infra. failing tests: none. full regression queue in progress, ETA ~45m.

sophia: I'll review PR #845 and leave comments. If no major issues, thumbs up.

jamie: I'll also scan the changelog and performance dashboards once the canary is live.

morgan: Blockers: need one more reviewer + confirm load-generator ops are ready. Also need docs updated (runtime/upgrade.md) — I'll open a small docs PR.

sophia: I can be the second reviewer. Marking it as in-progress.

morgan: thanks :heart: — if anyone on call in PST needs to be aware, the oncall is @tomas tonight. Ping him for emergency rollback.

tomas: got it. I'll keep an eye on alerts and latency dashboards.

morgan: asks: 1) reviewers for #845 (done — thanks @sophia & @jamie). 2) someone to confirm canary dashboards (volunteer?), 3) quick note in the all-hands after canary status.

alex: I'll watch the dashboards and post a short update here after 30m.

morgan: final: if you can, add a quick line to the rollout doc about observed perf delta and any mitigations. small bullets are fine.

jamie: will do.

morgan: Thanks all. I'll post a follow-up when canary moves to 80% or if we hit regressions. :rocket:
